payoff.note: Chapter 1 is schema-v2, so the payoff is atom-scored: PT-C01-practice assesses all eighteen atoms the chapter introduces. The ola writing runway (PT-W01) introduces no atoms of its own — it re-assesses ola's three — so the opener's typed writing evidence is already inside this set.
